rules.claim: $NVDA is still growing triple digits (FY2027 Q2)
requiredPassages: Revenue more than doubled from a year earlier to $96.22 billion
rules.excerpt: Revenue more than doubled from a year earlier to $96.22 billion
rules.title: AP reports NVIDIA's fiscal Q2 revenue growth
rules.titleZH: 美联社报道 NVIDIA 财季收入增长
rules.summary: AP reported quarterly revenue of about $96.22B, more than double the year-earlier level.
rules.summaryZH: 美联社报道，NVIDIA 当季收入约 962.2 亿美元，较上年同期翻倍以上。
rules.contextNote: Reported results do not establish the author's valuation or future growth estimates.
rules.contextNoteZH: 历史业绩不证明作者的估值判断或未来增长预测。

rules.claim: All eyes will be on the earnings results from $NVDA after the closing bell today.
rules.title: The results discussed in this opinion have been released
rules.titleZH: 这条观点关注的财报现已发布
rules.summary: AP subsequently covered NVIDIA's results. This is a follow-up to the author's pre-earnings view.
rules.summaryZH: 美联社随后报道了 NVIDIA 业绩，为作者财报前观点补充事件后续。
rules.contextNote: This does not verify the author's options-implied move or proposed entry price.
rules.contextNoteZH: 此报道不验证作者所说的期权隐含波动或拟买入价格。

rules.claim: Nebius upsized the deal from $4.5B to $5.0B, with an option to reach $5.75B.
rules.excerpt: $5.0 billion aggregate original principal amount of convertible senior notes
rules.title: Nebius prices an upsized convertible-note offering
rules.titleZH: Nebius 公布扩大后可转债发行定价
rules.summary: The company announced $5.0B of notes. The initial conversion prices for the two series were about $313.46 and $324.65.
rules.summaryZH: 公司公布 50 亿美元可转债发行，两批债券初始转股价分别约为 313.46 美元和 324.65 美元。
rules.contextNote: Conversion terms are not a guarantee of the stock's future price or the author's investment return.
rules.contextNoteZH: 转股条款不保证未来股价或作者预期的投资收益。

rules.claim: Nebius upsized the deal from $4.5B to $5.0B, with an option to reach $5.75B.
requiredPassages: The initial purchasers exercised in full their options
total aggregate original principal amount of the Notes is $5.75 billion
rules.excerpt: the total aggregate original principal amount of the Notes is $5.75 billion
rules.title: The convertible offering closes at $5.75B
rules.titleZH: 可转债发行完成，总额达到 57.5 亿美元
rules.summary: Nebius later announced completion of the offering, with the additional purchase options exercised in full.
rules.summaryZH: Nebius 随后宣布完成发行，额外购买权已全部行使，发行总额为 57.5 亿美元。
rules.contextNote: This is a later update to the same financing event, not an independent second confirmation or information known when the author posted.
rules.contextNoteZH: 这是同一融资事件的后续进展，并非独立的第二重验证，也不是作者发帖时已有的资料。

rules.title: Tavily joins Nebius's AI cloud platform
rules.titleZH: Tavily 纳入 Nebius AI 云平台
rules.summary: Nebius's company blog confirms the acquisition and describes integrating Tavily's search capabilities into its cloud platform.
rules.summaryZH: Nebius 公司博客确认收购 Tavily，并介绍将其搜索能力整合进云平台。
rules.contextNote: The acquisition does not establish the author's expected stock return or target price.
rules.contextNoteZH: 收购事实不证明作者预期的股票收益或目标价。
